FINAL SQL:
SELECT d.name
FROM Dogs d
JOIN Owners o ON d.owner_id = o.owner_id
WHERE o.owner_id IN (
    SELECT o2.owner_id
    FROM Owners o2
    JOIN Dogs d2 ON d2.owner_id = o2.owner_id
    LEFT JOIN Treatments t ON t.dog_id = d2.dog_id
    GROUP BY o2.owner_id
    HAVING COALESCE(SUM(t.cost_of_treatment), 0) <= 1000
);
